text: [excited] Eight percent a year. [pause] When does your money double?
[curious] There's a shortcut for this. [pause] They call it the Rule of seventy-two.
[confident] Take seventy-two, divide by the growth rate. [pause] That's your answer in years.
[curious] Our rate is eight. [pause] Seventy-two over eight is nine.
[excited] Nine years. [pause] And one point oh eight, nine times over? One point nine nine nine.
[thoughtful] But only from four to twelve percent. [pause] At fifty it claims one point four four — really one point seven one. [warm] Try your own rate.
